text.description_html:
Acorn PS7YP, Teacup Ceramic Cabinet Knob

Add a touch of whimsey to your home with acorn's Teacup Cabinet Knob. It is hand painted on ceramic. Easy to install, it is a quick way to liven up your kitchen cupboards or your china cabinet. It is 1-7/8 inches squared.

Features of the Teacup Cabinet Knob:

  • Length: 1-7/8" square
  • Material: ceramic
  • Each design is hand painted on ceramic.
  • Package includes 1 knob and hardware for installation.

Sold Individually. Due to the hand painted nature of this product, the colors will vary slightly.
